consistency_issues.en: Good bye and don't forget me!
Oh hello, nice to see you |PLAYERNAME|. Are you here to hear some stories of my {adventures} or do you need {help}?
variants: Oh ciao, piacere di vederti |PLAYERNAME|. Sei qui per ascoltare alcune storie del mio {adventures} o hai bisogno di {help}?
Oh ciao, piacere di vederti |PLAYERNAME|. Sei qui per ascoltare alcune storie del mio {adventures} o ti serve {help}?

consistency_issues.en: Hello, I am the warden of this {monument}. The {sarcophagus} in front of you was established to prevent people from going {down} there. But I doubt that this step is sufficient.
variants: Ciao, sono il direttore di questo {monument}. Il {sarcophagus} davanti a te è stato istituito per impedire alle persone di andare lì {down}. Ma dubito che questo passaggio sia sufficiente.
Ciao, sono il direttore di questo {monument}. Il {sarcophagus} di fronte a te è stato creato per impedire alle persone di andarci {down}. Ma dubito che questo passaggio sia sufficiente.

consistency_issues.en: Well, let's see if your mission was successful. Just bring me all needed {materials}.
variants: Bene, vediamo se la tua missione ha avuto successo. Portami solo tutto il necessario {materials}.
Bene, vediamo se la tua missione ha avuto successo. Portami tutto il necessario {materials}.

consistency_issues.en: But there are few volunteers. Often the crystal gatherers disappear and are never seen again. Other poor fellows then meet their former shipmates in the form of ghosts or skeletons. It's a {cursed} area, something evil is down there!
variants: Ma i volontari sono pochi. Spesso i raccoglitori di cristalli scompaiono e non vengono mai più visti. Altri poveretti incontrano poi i loro ex compagni di bordo sotto forma di fantasmi o scheletri. È una zona {cursed}, c'è qualcosa di malvagio laggiù!

Ma i volontari sono pochi. Spesso i raccoglitori di cristalli scompaiono e non vengono mai più visti. Altri poveretti incontrano poi i loro ex compagni di bordo sotto forma di fantasmi o scheletri. È una zona {cursed}, laggiù c'è qualcosa di malvagio!

pl_reference_issues.pl: Nie możesz tak szybko przenosić tego przedmiotu.

pl_reference_issues.en: So receive my prayer: 'Wicked curses shall be broken'. Now, bring your stake to Kasmir in Darashia for the next line of the prayer. I will inform him what to do.
pl_reference_issues.pl: Przyjmij więc moją modlitwę: 'Wicked curses shall be broken'. Teraz przynieś swój kołek Kasmirowi w Darashia, aby wysłuchać następnej linijki modlitwy. Poinformuję go, co ma robić.
pl_reference_issues.lang: So receive my prayer: 'Wicked curses shall be broken'. Now, bring your stake to Kasmir in Darashia for the next line of the prayer. I will inform him what to do.

pl_reference_issues.en: You should visit Kasmir in Darashia now, my child.
pl_reference_issues.pl: Powinieneś teraz odwiedzić Kasmira w Darashii, moje dziecko.
pl_reference_issues.lang: You should visit Kasmir in Darashia now, my child.

pl_reference_issues.en: MoTA is short for the recently founded Museum of Tibian Arts. We work together in close collaboration. New {results} are communicated to the museum instantly.
pl_reference_issues.pl: MoTA to skrót od niedawno założonego Muzeum Sztuki Tibijskiej. Współpracujemy ze sobą w ścisłej współpracy. Nowe {results} są natychmiast przekazywane muzeum.
pl_reference_issues.lang: MoTA is short for the recently founded Museum of Tibian Arts. We work together in close collaboration. New {results} are communicated to the museum instantly.

pl_reference_issues.en: Did you get the requested pickaxe from Uzgod in Kazordoon?
pl_reference_issues.pl: Zdobyłeś zamówiony kilof od Uzgoda w Kazordoon?
pl_reference_issues.lang: Did you get the requested pickaxe from Uzgod in Kazordoon?

pl_reference_issues.en: You should visit Tyrias in Liberty Bay now.
pl_reference_issues.pl: Powinieneś teraz odwiedzić Tyriasa w Liberty Bay.
pl_reference_issues.lang: You should visit Tyrias in Liberty Bay now.

pl_reference_issues.en: My name is Captain Bluebear from the Royal Tibia Line.
pl_reference_issues.pl: Nazywam się Kapitan Bluebear z Królewskiej Linii Tibia.
pl_reference_issues.lang: My name is Captain Bluebear from the Royal Tibia Line.

pl_reference_issues.en: I can bring you to our base in Liberty Bay for |TRAVELCOST|. Is that what you want?
pl_reference_issues.pl: Mogę Cię zabrać do naszej bazy w Liberty Bay na |TRAVELCOST|. Czy tego właśnie chcesz?
pl_reference_issues.lang: I can bring you to our base in Liberty Bay for |TRAVELCOST|. Is that what you want?

pl_reference_issues.lang: You help?? Human know troll lady for Grarkharok??

pl_reference_issues.en: Like it?? Hope troll lady also like it!

pl_reference_issues.lang: Welcome to the finest {armor} shop in the land, |PLAYERNAME|!

pl_reference_issues.lang: Hi there! Are you here for the {shooting} test or to {report} your success?
